```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
# Load the data
data_all_bulk <- readRDS("../bulkBCR-seq/data_rep_all")

# Remove the two mice with very small sample size in the bulkseq data
data_all_bulk$data <- data_all_bulk$data[-c(8,36,79,111)]
data_all_bulk$meta <- data_all_bulk$meta[-c(8,36,79,111),]

# Sort the bulkseq df by order of descending UMI counts
data_all_bulk$data <- map(data_all_bulk$data, function(x) arrange(x, desc(Clones)))

data_all_bulk$meta$Method <- "bulk"
data_all_bulk$meta$Chain <- str_split(data_all_bulk$meta$Sample, "_", simplify = T)[,4]
data_all_bulk$meta$Infection_1 <- str_remove_all(data_all_bulk$meta$Infection_1, "H1N1_")
data_all_bulk$meta$Infection_1 <- str_replace_all(data_all_bulk$meta$Infection_1, "PR08", "PR8")
data_all_bulk$meta$Infection_2 <- str_remove_all(data_all_bulk$meta$Infection_2, "H1N1_")
data_all_bulk$meta$Infection_2 <- str_replace_all(data_all_bulk$meta$Infection_2, "PR08", "PR8")
data_all_bulk$meta$Infections <- str_remove_all(data_all_bulk$meta$Infections, "H1N1_")
data_all_bulk$meta$Infections <- str_replace_all(data_all_bulk$meta$Infections, "PR08", "PR8")

# Rename the bulk samples
names(data_all_bulk$data) <-  paste(data_all_bulk$meta$Method, data_all_bulk$meta$Sample_Number, data_all_bulk$meta$Infections, data_all_bulk$meta$Replicate, data_all_bulk$meta$Chain, sep = "_")

data_all_sc <- readRDS("../scBCR-seq/data_all_sc.RDS")

# Sort the sc df by order of descending cell barcode counts
data_all_sc$data <- map(data_all_sc$data, function(x) arrange(x, desc(Clones)))

# Rename the bulk samples
names(data_all_sc$data) <-  paste(data_all_sc$meta$Method, "all", data_all_sc$meta$Infections, data_all_sc$meta$Replicate, data_all_sc$meta$Chain, sep = "_")

data_all_both <- list(data = c(data_all_bulk$data, data_all_sc$data),
                      meta = rbind(data_all_bulk$meta, data_all_sc$meta))
data_all_both$meta$Sample <- names(data_all_both$data)

# Save the formatted data
saveRDS(data_all_both, "./data_all_both")
```

```{r}
# Load the data
data_all_both <- readRDS("./data_all_both")
```

# Clonotype count (after filtering out unidentified and misidentified isotype clonotypes) and Number of reads per repertoire (after alignment and UMI error correction)

```{r Clonotype_count, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
volume_all <- repExplore(data_all_both$data, "volume")
volume_all <- merge(volume_all, data_all_both$meta)
```

```{r echo=FALSE, fig.height=20, fig.width=12, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
p_vol_heavy_bulk <- ggplot(data = volume_all %>% filter(Method == "bulk" & Chain == "hc"), aes(x = factor(Infections, levels = c("PBS;PBS", "PBS;CA07", "CA07;CA07", "PR8;CA07")), y = Volume, fill = factor(Infections, levels = c("PBS;PBS", "PBS;CA07", "CA07;CA07", "PR8;CA07")))) +
  geom_col(show.legend = T, color = "black") +
  theme_half_open() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0), legend.position = "bottom") + #Rotate text
  labs(title = "Unique bulk clonotype count heavy chain by replicate", x = "Infections", y = "Count", fill = "Infections") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#abadaf", "#fbc8ac", "#7aa2da", "#7fb884")) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Volume), size = 3, position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5)) +
  facet_wrap(vars(Replicate))

p_vol_heavy_sc <- ggplot(data = volume_all %>% filter(Method == "sc" & Chain == "hc")) +
  geom_col(aes(x = factor(Infections, levels = c("PBS;PBS", "PBS;CA07", "CA07;CA07", "PR8;CA07")), y = Volume, fill = factor(Infections, levels = c("PBS;PBS", "PBS;CA07", "CA07;CA07", "PR8;CA07"))), show.legend = T, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#abadaf", "#fbc8ac", "#7aa2da", "#7fb884")) +
  theme_half_open() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0), legend.position = "bottom") + #Rotate text
  labs(title = "Unique sc clonotype count heavy chain by replicate", x = "Infections", y = "Count", fill = "Infections") +
  geom_text(aes(x = Infections, y = Volume, label = Volume), vjust = -0.3, size = 3, position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)) +
  facet_wrap(vars(Replicate))


p_vol_light_bulk <- ggplot(data = volume_all %>% filter(Method == "bulk" & Chain == "lc"), aes(x = factor(Infections, levels = c("PBS;PBS", "PBS;CA07", "CA07;CA07", "PR8;CA07")), y = Volume, fill = factor(Infections, levels = c("PBS;PBS", "PBS;CA07", "CA07;CA07", "PR8;CA07")))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#abadaf", "#fbc8ac", "#7aa2da", "#7fb884")) +
  geom_col(show.legend = T, color = "black") +
  theme_half_open() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0), legend.position = "bottom") + #Rotate text
  labs(title = "Unique bulk clonotype count light chain by replicate", x = "Infections", y = "Count", fill = "Infections") +
  geom_text(aes(label = Volume), size = 3, position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5)) +
  facet_wrap(vars(Replicate))

p_vol_light_sc <- ggplot(data = volume_all %>% filter(Method == "sc" & Chain == "lc")) +
  geom_col(aes(x = factor(Infections, levels = c("PBS;PBS", "PBS;CA07", "CA07;CA07", "PR8;CA07")), y = Volume, fill = factor(Infections, levels = c("PBS;PBS", "PBS;CA07", "CA07;CA07", "PR8;CA07"))), show.legend = T, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#abadaf", "#fbc8ac", "#7aa2da", "#7fb884")) +
  theme_half_open() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0), legend.position = "bottom") + #Rotate text
  labs(title = "Unique sc clonotype count light chain by replicate", x = "Infections", y = "Count", fill = "Infections") +
  geom_text(aes(x = Infections, y = Volume, label = Volume), vjust = -0.3, size = 3, position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)) +
  facet_wrap(vars(Replicate))

p_vol_all <- plot_grid(p_vol_heavy_bulk, p_vol_heavy_sc, p_vol_light_bulk, p_vol_light_sc, ncol = 1)
p_vol_all
#ggsave("./figures/clone_count_all.pdf", p_vol_all, height = 20, width = 12, dpi = 600)
```

*Figure 1: The clonotype count was skewed towards PBS;PBS mice in replicate 1, very few PBS;PBS mice in replicate 2, and most even in replicate 3, in both bulk and single-cell samples*

```{r Clonotype_and_read_count, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
read_all <- repExplore(data_all_both$data, "clones")
read_all <- merge(read_all, data_all_both$meta)
```

```{r echo=FALSE, fig.height=5, fig.width=12, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
p_read_sc <- ggplot(data = read_all %>% filter(Method == "sc" & Chain == "hc")) +
  geom_col(aes(x = factor(Infections, levels = c("PBS;PBS", "PBS;CA07", "CA07;CA07", "PR8;CA07")), y = Clones, fill = factor(Infections, levels = c("PBS;PBS", "PBS;CA07", "CA07;CA07", "PR8;CA07"))), show.legend = T, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#abadaf", "#fbc8ac", "#7aa2da", "#7fb884")) +
  theme_half_open() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0), legend.position = "bottom") + #Rotate text
  labs(title = "Scseq unique cell count by replicate", x = "Infections", y = "Count", fill = "Infections") +
  geom_text(aes(x = Infections, y = Clones, label = Clones), vjust = -0.3, size = 3, position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)) +
  facet_wrap(vars(Replicate))

p_read_sc
#ggsave("./figures/cell_count_sc.pdf", p_read_sc, height = 5, width = 12, dpi = 600)
```

*Figure 2: We recovered 462 cells in rep 1, 3281 cells in rep 2 (very few PBS;PBS cells), and around 3566 cells in rep 3 (cells are kept if both chains are present and the hashtag can separate the cells into 1 of the 4 treatment groups). Cell hashing was demultiplexed using HTODemux in Seurat from CellRanger output.*

```{r}
# Visualize top 100 HC clonotypes in sc data with respect to Ag-binding
p_sc_top100 <- map2(data_all_both$data[intersect(grep("sc",names(data_all_both$data)), grep("hc",names(data_all_both$data)))],
                    names(data_all_both$data[intersect(grep("sc",names(data_all_both$data)), grep("hc",names(data_all_both$data)))]),
                    function(a,b)
ggplot(data = a[1:100,], mapping = aes(x = seq_len(nrow(a[1:100,])), y = Clones)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = HA.binding)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("CA07" = "#E41A1C", "Cross" = "#984EA3", "PR8" = "#377EB8"), 
                    na.value = "#bdbdbd") +
  labs(x = "Clone index", y = "Cell counts", title = b) +
  theme_half_open()
)
```

```{r fig.height=12, fig.width=18}
p_top100_sc <- plot_grid(plotlist = p_sc_top100)
p_top100_sc
#ggsave("./figures/top100_sc_binding.pdf", p_top100_sc, height = 12, width = 18, dpi = 600)
```

*Figure 3: Top 100 clonotypes in single-cell repertoires, colored by Ag-binding. In general, there is more clonal expansion in infected mice compared to control mice, and the most expanded clonotypes are either CA07 or CA07+PR8 binding.*


```{r}

names(ann_colors$Replicate) <- unique(ann_df$Replicate)

names(ann_colors$Method) <- unique(ann_df$Method)
```

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
# Export sc CDR3 as a whole replicate, with info on infections for network analysis
data_sc_hc <- data_all_both$data[intersect(str_which(names(data_all_both$data), "sc"),
                                           str_which(names(data_all_both$data), "hc"))]

for (i in 1:length(data_sc_hc)){
  data_sc_hc[[i]]$Replicate <- str_split(names(data_sc_hc[i]),"_",simplify = T)[,4]
}

cdr3_sc_hc <- tibble()
for (i in 1:length(data_sc_hc)){
  df_tmp <- tibble()
  df_tmp <- data_sc_hc[[i]] %>% select(CDR3.aa, HA.binding, Infections, Replicate)
  cdr3_sc_hc <- rbind(cdr3_sc_hc, df_tmp)
  }

data_sc_lc <- data_all_both$data[intersect(str_which(names(data_all_both$data), "sc"),
                                           str_which(names(data_all_both$data), "lc"))]

for (i in 1:length(data_sc_lc)){
  data_sc_lc[[i]]$Replicate <- str_split(names(data_sc_lc[i]),"_",simplify = T)[,4]
}

cdr3_sc_lc <- tibble()
for (i in 1:length(data_sc_lc)){
  df_tmp <- tibble()
  df_tmp <- data_sc_lc[[i]] %>% select(CDR3.aa, HA.binding, Infections, Replicate)
  cdr3_sc_lc <- rbind(cdr3_sc_lc, df_tmp)
}

write_tsv(cdr3_sc_hc, "./Clonal_network_analysis/cdr3/cdr3_sc_hc.tsv")
write_tsv(cdr3_sc_lc, "./Clonal_network_analysis/cdr3/cdr3_sc_lc.tsv")
```

# Bulk_single-cell repertoire analysis
# VH gene usage (remember to replace with IMGT names later from ORGDB table)

```{r VH-gene_usage, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#V gene usage heavy chain
gene_use_vh <- geneUsage(data_all_both$data[str_which(names(data_all_both$data),"hc")], .gene= c("musmus.ighv"), .ambig = "maj", .quant = "count", .norm = TRUE)

# Set NA to 0 for correlation calculation
gene_use_vh[is.na(gene_use_vh)] <- 0

# Load the csv file translating OGRDB gene names to IMGT names
ogrdb_gene_list <- read.csv("./OGRDB_to_IGMT_Vgene.csv")
ogrdb_Vgene <- ogrdb_gene_list %>% filter(str_detect(Label,"IGHV"))
ogrdb_Vgene$IMGT.Name <- na_if(ogrdb_Vgene$IMGT.Name,"")
ogrdb_Vgene$IMGT.Name[which(is.na(ogrdb_Vgene$IMGT.Name))] <- ogrdb_Vgene$Alt.Names[which(is.na(ogrdb_Vgene$IMGT.Name))]
ogrdb_Vgene$Label <- str_sub(ogrdb_Vgene$Label, end = -2L)

# Replace the OGRDB names with the IMGT names one by one
for (i in 1:nrow(gene_use_vh)){
  gene_use_vh$Names <- str_replace(gene_use_vh$Names, gene_use_vh$Names[i], ogrdb_Vgene$IMGT.Name[i])
}

# Convert to matrix format for heatmap of gene usage
gene_use_vh_mat <- gene_use_vh %>% column_to_rownames(var = "Names")
```

```{r fig.height=20, fig.width=16, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
p_vh_gene_usage <- as.ggplot(pheatmap(gene_use_vh_mat, cluster_rows = F, cluster_cols = T, clustering_method = "ward.D2",
         angle_col = 90, cutree_cols = 3,
         annotation_col = ann_df, annotation_colors = ann_colors,
         color = colorRampPalette(c("#f7fbff", "#08306b"))(length(seq(round(min(gene_use_vh_mat, na.rm = T), 2), round(max(gene_use_vh_mat, na.rm = T), 2), by = 0.01)))
         ))

#ggsave("./figures/vh_gene_usage.pdf", p_vh_gene_usage, height = 20, width = 16, dpi = 600)
```

*Figure 4: Without regarding the Ag-specificity of each clonotype, the scseq samples (GC B cells) have a clearly distinct VH-gene usage profile from the bulkseq samples (BMPCs).*

# Merge samples from 3 replicates into larger samples based of HA binding

```{r include=FALSE}
data_all_sc <- data_all_both
data_all_sc$data <- data_all_both$data[str_which(names(data_all_both$data),"sc")]
data_all_sc$meta <- data_all_both$meta %>% filter(Method == "sc")

# Add columns for replicates and chain
for (i in 1:length(data_all_sc$data)){
  data_all_sc$data[[i]]$Replicate <- data_all_sc$meta$Replicate[i]
  data_all_sc$data[[i]]$Chain <- data_all_sc$meta$Chain[i]
}

# Filter clonotypes on HA binding
HA_CA07 <- map(data_all_sc$data, function(x) x %>% filter(HA.binding == "CA07"))
HA_Cross <- map(data_all_sc$data, function(x) x %>% filter(HA.binding == "Cross"))
HA_PR8 <- map(data_all_sc$data, function(x) x %>% filter(HA.binding == "PR8"))

# Keep only dfs with observations
HA_Cross <- HA_Cross %>% keep(~ nrow(.x) != 0)
HA_PR8 <- HA_PR8 %>% keep(~ nrow(.x) != 0)

# Create larger samples based only on HA binding
HA_CA07 <- bind_rows(HA_CA07)
HA_Cross <- bind_rows(HA_Cross)
HA_PR8 <- bind_rows(HA_PR8)


data_all_sc2 <- list(HA_CA07, HA_Cross, HA_PR8)
names(data_all_sc2) <- c("HA_CA07", "HA_Cross", "HA_PR8")

# Re-calculate the clonal proportions
for (i in 1:length(data_all_sc2)){
  data_all_sc2[[i]]$Proportion <- data_all_sc2[[i]]$Clones/sum(data_all_sc2[[i]]$Clones)
}
```

# Use the HA binding data in scseq samples to label bulkseq data
```{r}
data_all_bulk <- data_all_both
data_all_bulk$data <- data_all_both$data[str_which(names(data_all_both$data),"bulk")]
data_all_bulk$meta <- data_all_both$meta %>% filter(Method == "bulk")

# Add a column called clonotype with V+J+CDR3aa in scseq and bulkseq
for (i in 1:length(data_all_sc2)){
  data_all_sc2[[i]]$Clonotype <- paste(data_all_sc2[[i]]$V.name, data_all_sc2[[i]]$J.name, data_all_sc2[[i]]$CDR3.aa, sep = ";")
}

for (i in 1:length(data_all_bulk$data)){
  data_all_bulk$data[[i]]$Clonotype <- paste(data_all_bulk$data[[i]]$V.name, data_all_bulk$data[[i]]$J.name, data_all_bulk$data[[i]]$CDR3.aa, sep = ";")
}
# Extract all sc clonotypes with their HA binding
clonotypes_CA07 <- unique(data_all_sc2$HA_CA07$Clonotype)
clonotypes_Cross <- unique(data_all_sc2$HA_Cross$Clonotype)
clonotypes_PR8 <- unique(data_all_sc2$HA_PR8$Clonotype)

# Get rid of the shared clonotypes between the Ag-specific groups
clonotypes_CA07_unique <- setdiff(clonotypes_CA07, c(clonotypes_Cross, clonotypes_PR8))
clonotypes_Cross_unique <- setdiff(clonotypes_Cross, c(clonotypes_CA07, clonotypes_PR8))
clonotypes_PR8_unique <- setdiff(clonotypes_PR8, c(clonotypes_CA07, clonotypes_Cross))

# Use left join to add HA binding data to bulkseq
# LABEL the clonotypes in bulkseq that were detected in the Ag-specific data

# Create a df version of the Ag-specific clonotypes and add to original data using left join
clonotypes_CA07_unique_df <- tibble(Clonotype = clonotypes_CA07_unique, HA.binding = "CA07")
clonotypes_Cross_unique_df <- tibble(Clonotype = clonotypes_Cross_unique, HA.binding = "Cross")
clonotypes_PR8_unique_df <- tibble(Clonotype = clonotypes_PR8_unique, HA.binding = "PR8")
clonotypes_allAg_unique_df <- bind_rows(clonotypes_CA07_unique_df, clonotypes_Cross_unique_df, clonotypes_PR8_unique_df)

# Label the bulkseq data with detected Ag-specific clones using left join
data_all_bulk$data <- map(data_all_bulk$data, function(x) 
  left_join(x, clonotypes_allAg_unique_df, by = "Clonotype"))

```

# Make barplot of clonotype frequency of top 500 clones, colored by HA binding

```{r}
p_bulk_top500 <- map2(data_all_bulk$data, names(data_all_bulk$data), function(a,b)
ggplot(data = a[1:500,], mapping = aes(x = seq_len(nrow(a[1:500,])), y = Clones)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = HA.binding)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("CA07" = "#E41A1C", "Cross" = "#984EA3", "PR8" = "#377EB8"), na.value = "#bdbdbd") +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(x = "Clone index", y = "UMI counts", title = b) +
  theme_half_open()
)
```

# Export the CDRH3 sequences from the top 1000 clones with HA binding to use in clonal network analysis
```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
# Take the top 1000 clones from bulkseq data
for (i in 1:length(data_all_bulk$data)){
  df_tmp <- tibble()
  df_tmp <- data_all_bulk$data[[i]][1:1000,] %>% select(CDR3.aa, HA.binding)
  write_tsv(df_tmp, file = paste0("./Clonal_network_analysis/cdr3_bulk_top1000/", names(data_all_bulk$data[i]), ".tsv"))
}
```
